title: Cook Japanese office maps into SM6 RT package
objective: Cook/package the Japanese office and Japanese office dark maps into the current Linux Standalone-Development package using the existing Vulkan SM6/hardware RT project configuration, so examples/flashlight/run.py --map japanese_office and --map japanese_office_dark can load without map-not-found errors.
instructions: Use the existing Unreal Engine path /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 and conda environment spear-env, matching the recent successful cafeteria cook workflow.
Use clean archive/stage/package/pak output so Standalone-Development/Linux/SpearSim/Content/Paks/SpearSim-Linux.pak is refreshed.
After cooking, verify the pak listing contains both Japanese office map entries and the VULKAN_SM6 global shader cache.
Do not run live runtime validation unless a display-capable session is available; report if DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY are absent.
constraints: Do not modify product source code.
expected_outputs: Cook/package status and exact user run commands for both Japanese office aliases.
Pak verification for Demonstration, Demonstration_Dark, and GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin.
definition_of_done: Both Japanese office maps are present in the refreshed standalone package or a clear blocker is reported.
